# Agents & orchestration

Persistent agents that message each other, questions that wait for you, background jobs, threads on other hosts, and the tools, skills and MCP servers agents use.

Pack id `agents`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/agents`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/agents/README.md) — Persistent, mentionable agents: identity, instructions, model route and tool preset, dispatched into an ordinary thread.
2. [`@dshfiles/agent-communication`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/agent-communication/README.md) — A passive communication browser and durable topic/direct inbox for independent DSH Agents.
3. [`@dshfiles/agent-questions`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/agent-questions/README.md) — Durable parent-scoped question and answer contract for DSH subagents.
4. [`@dshfiles/background-jobs`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/background-jobs/README.md) — Every background job of every Session on one page: live jobs from the job registry, finished ones from session logs, classified by what they do.
5. [`@dshfiles/multi-host`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/multi-host/README.md) — Run new threads on other machines over SSH or a pairing-code link: host directory, pooled tunnels, link gateway, host chip and remote thread view.
6. [`@dshfiles/agent-toolkit`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/agent-toolkit/README.md) — An Agent toolkit page: the tools, plugins, MCP servers, skills and memory the agent can use in the current thread.
7. [`@dshfiles/capabilities-hub`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/capabilities-hub/README.md) — A Capabilities hub page: one launch point for agent skills, MCP servers and DSH plugins that opens each owner's own manager, with skills.sh link-out guidance and separate trust labels.
8. [`@dshfiles/mcp-servers`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/mcp-servers/README.md) — Manage profile-wide MCP server configurations and native DSH MCP clients.
9. [`@dshfiles/mcp-endpoint`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/mcp-endpoint/README.md) — An MCP server (streamable HTTP, bearer token) on the DSH Web server, so Claude Code or Codex in a terminal can list, start, message, wait on and stop DSH threads.

## Prerequisites

1. An AI account is configured.

## Key settings

1. **Stop background jobs that outlive their thread**: Settings entry `dshfiles-background-jobs`, field `stopOutlivedAfterMinutes`.

3. **Submit and resolve anchored Markdown feedback** (`agent-questions`) — Submit line-anchored feedback against the current document revision and deliver accepted, rejected, or deferred resolution receipts to the child.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Agents & orchestration under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `agents`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs agents` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
